theme.description: Premium, exclusive, and trust-driven digital showroom. Black and Gold dominance, avoiding gaudy excess by utilizing generous negative space and stark contrasts.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for English, paired with traditional Nasta'liq for Urdu.

english.headings: Playfair Display, serif (Weights: 400, 600, 700) - for elegance and heritage.
english.body: Outfit or Manrope, sans-serif (Weights: 300, 400, 500) - for high legibility in dense UI.
english.rates_numbers: Outfit or JetBrains Mono - tabular numbers for live rates.

urdu_sindhi.headings: Noto Nastaliq Urdu (for authentic, classic feel).
urdu_sindhi.body: Noto Sans Arabic (clean and readable at small sizes).

rules: CRITICAL: Do not use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Implement dynamic dir='rtl' for Urdu/Sindhi language selections.
Tinted Grey Rule: All greys and blacks must have a warm/brown undertone (e.g., #12100E) to complement the gold.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF).

visual_enhancers.shimmer_sweep: Use Framer Motion to create a passing light reflection effect (linear-gradient) over the Live Rates card and Splash Screen logo.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For Sticky Header and Bottom Nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#080706]/70 with a delicate 1px top/bottom border of border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Cards should use the 'Tactile' Neumorphism variant tailored for dark mode: flat surface (#12100E), 1px solid border-white/5, and subtle inner glow on hover.

components_needed.name: Cinematic Splash Screen
components_needed.description: Full screen overlay. Fades in Roman Urdu dialogue ('Khaliq-e-Haqiqi ke fazl se...', '19+ Years of Trust'), followed by Arif Jewellers Logo reveal. A gold shimmer sweeps across the logo before routing to Home.

components_needed.name: Live Gold/Silver Rates Card
components_needed.description: Hero card on Home. Displays 24K, 22K, 21K, and Silver rates per city. Includes 'Last Updated' timestamp. Triggers a soft gold shimmer animation upon data fetch/update.

components_needed.name: Bottom Navigation
components_needed.description: Fixed at bottom. 5 items: Home, Collections, Live Rates, Wishlist, Profile. Must look native (app-like) with safe-area padding.

components_needed.name: Floating Action Buttons
components_needed.description: Always visible bottom-right (above bottom nav). WhatsApp and Call icons, styled luxuriously (gold or green subtle glow).

components_needed.name: Product Detail Layout
components_needed.description: Large edge-to-edge product image carousel. Title, weight, purity, making charges info. Massive 'Ask Price via WhatsApp' primary button.

components_needed.name: Hidden Admin Panel
components_needed.description: Accessible via a discreet Gear icon in Profile. Requires basic auth. Allows CRUD for Live Rates, Products, and Reviews.

grids_and_layouts.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background relative shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden (creates a mobile-app frame on desktop, full screen on mobile).
grids_and_layouts.home_layout: Bento Grid (High Density) for Categories: mix of col-span-1 and col-span-2 tiles to create visual tension.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) to exude luxury. Cramped text feels cheap.
rules: Hide standard scrollbars (use CSS to hide webkit-scrollbar) to enhance the native app feel.

patterns: Page Transitions: Slight scale up (0.98 to 1) and fade in on route change.
List Staggering: New arrivals and Categories fade in sequentially.
3D Touch: Active state on cards and buttons scales down slightly (scale: 0.97) to simulate physical touch.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gold buttons is dark (#12100E) for WCAG/APCA compliance.
accessibility.rtl_support: Implement dynamic flex directions and text alignments for Urdu/Sindhi.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-fab-button').

images_to_use.description: Luxury gold necklace with diamonds on elegant black background
Close up of a ring on a black surface
South Asian woman in traditional bridal attire and gold jewelry

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Framer Motion for the UI transitions and Shimmer effects. 3D WebGL is overkill for an app optimizing for quick loading in Sindh on mobile networks. Rely on high-res HD images and fluid 2D motion (CSS/Framer) for luxury feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components using standard .js / .jsx syntax.
Implement the 'Cinematic Splash' as a one-time overlay using framer-motion when the app loads.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the Bottom Nav or Headers. Use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#080706]/80`.
Ensure standard HTML input/select are NOT used; rely on Shadcn/custom UI components styled heavily in black/gold.
Always apply data-testid to buttons, inputs, links.

Since it's a mobile PWA experience, wrap the main router content in a div with max-w-md mx-auto to look like an app on desktop, and ensure pb-24 padding at the bottom so the Bottom Nav doesn't obscure content.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
